industry.role: Machine Learning Engineer & Telemetry Team Lead
industry.summary: Building simulations and behavioral measurement systems for a Duke-funded startup focused on research and peer-review workflows.
contributions: Extended a Python multi-agent simulation of peer-review markets with continuous and discrete effort models, reviewer-dependent pricing, and nonlinear review rewards. Added multi-seed experiments and agent-level diagnostics to compare reinforcement-learning policies with heuristic and stochastic baselines.

Designed telemetry across nine platform workflows, defining 142 event types to measure task completion, abandonment, latency, and interaction friction and distinguish usability problems from technical failures.
Implemented TypeScript tracking helpers, structured event validation, and sensitive-data filtering for consistent behavioral analysis.

Led telemetry engineering from measurement specification through implementation and technical handoff, coordinating instrumentation contracts, integration guidance, and staging QA with platform engineers.

industry.summary: Analyzed adoption and engagement signals for Lark’s Indonesia localization project.
contributions: Analyzed user behavior, adoption channels, and engagement data to understand how people adopted collaboration tools in a new market.
Organized user interviews, community feedback, and creator-channel data into behavioral signals for user segmentation and engagement-barrier analysis.
Developed a data-informed process for evaluating creator and community acquisition channels, tracking conversion outcomes and identifying promising signals for localized product adoption.

projects.summary: Evaluated medical-device recycling feasibility across China, Singapore, and the United States.
contributions: Organized regulatory, market, and infrastructure evidence into a structured data-processing and comparison workflow.
Compared policy requirements, operational constraints, and market readiness to assess implementation feasibility and risks.
Developed a rule-based ranking and decision-support framework for country-level recommendations.

projects.summary: Supported growth and product evaluation for a climate-focused application through user and community data.
contributions: Processed user-interaction, outreach, and community-engagement data to analyze acquisition, activation, and retention patterns.
Developed user segmentation and channel-ranking logic to identify promising creators, ambassadors, and early users.
Built a process for monitoring outreach performance, community growth, and user feedback to inform product experiments and adoption strategy.
